names: A cohort member's 180-day return is refused when it has no close within 4 days of either end of the window (the routine gap between two trading days, the bound the benchmark leg beside it already holds), and the cohort's source names how many were refused and each one's last close; the comps panel's date is matched only to a close within 4 days before its export stamp, and an uncorrected stamp names a match it refused further back. On the 2026-11-11 store GOOGL's cohort read EXTR, NN, AAPL and MSFT on closes from 06-12 to 07-02 under an 11-11 end (EXTR +20.8% over 48 days, labelled 180-day); on the 2026-11-10 store WERN's 27.84 matched 2025-10-17 and refused its panel at 392 days.
